headline: Public hearing on Eversource parking lot paving and stormwater upgrades at 206 Calvary Street, plus a certificate of compliance for 231 Lexington Street.
summary: Audrey Hunt filed the Calvary Street notice for NSTAR Energy Co. d/b/a Eversource Energy. Matt Tiano of Tiana and Tiano, LLC filed the Lexington Street request, which adds a 336 square foot loading area, a second story, and more parking pavement.
items: Public hearing: Notice of Intent (DEP File # 316-tba) for 180, 206-R12, and 206 Calvary Street
Applicant for Calvary Street: Audrey Hunt / NSTAR Energy Co. d/b/a Eversource Energy

Public meeting: Request for Certificate of Compliance (DEP File # 316-0607) for 231 Lexington Street

Lexington Street project: 336 square foot loading area addition, second story addition, more parking pavement, and site work

Old business: possible scheduling of Paine/Storer boundary walk in November or December

Waltham Conservation Commission 
November 5, 2026 
7:00 p.m. 
Meeting Agenda 
 
 
Pursuant to the relevant legislation, including Mass. Acts 2025 c.2, this meeting will take place 
remotely. All Open Meeting Law requirements will be met and public access will be available by Zoom 
call. Residents who need a device to connect are invited to use a public desktop or borrow a 
laptop at the Waltham public library (valid library card required). 
For this meeting, members of the public may participate by joining at: 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88047114594?pwd=WyzmT8K5ICU03H0MaYobrp5StH1gO0.1 
Passcode: Waltham 
We will post a link to the video recording at http://www.wcac.org/government/meetings/conservation-
commission as soon as possible after the meeting. 
 
 
Public Hearing 
Notice of Intent (DEP File # 316-tba) 
Applicant: Audrey Hunt / NSTAR Energy Co. d/b/a Eversource Energy 
Property Location: 180, 206-R12, 206 Calvary Street 
Project Description: Paving and striping of an existing parking lot, stormwater management 
infrastructure upgrades, and associated ancillary work. 
 
 
 
Public Meeting 
Request for Certificate of Compliance (DEP File # 316-0607) 
Applicant: Matt Tiano, Tiana and Tiano, LLC 
Property Location: 231Lexington Street 
Project Description: Expansion of an existing commercial building to include a 336 s.f. addition to be 
utilized as a loading area, a second story addition, and additional pavement for parking. Work also 
includes associated site development improvements to grading, landscaping and drainage. A later 
amendment to the filing increased the paved parking area by one space. 
 
 
 
Commission Business 
• Approval of meeting minutes from 10-22-2026.
Correspondence 
• INFORMATIONAL: National Grid has notified of gas main replacement work in the right-of-way of 
Forest Street, planned for fall/winter 2026- 2027. A portion is in buffer zone but is exempt 
maintenance activity.  
 
Old Business 
• Conservation Restrictions. Update. 
• Possible scheduling of Paine/Storer boundary walk  (Nov./Dec.). To be discussed at the next 
meeting. 
 
Site Visit Reports 
• 101 Elm Street (Prestige car wash). 
• 44 Shore Road. 
 
Committee Reports 
• CPC: Next meeting scheduled for November 17. 
 
New Business 
•
